newsitem.title: INDIA: India Maruti says tough to maintain 96/97 profit.
newsitem.headline: India Maruti says tough to maintain 96/97 profit.

text.p: India's Maruti Udyog Ltd said on Monday that it will be difficult for the company to maintain its 1996/97 (April-March) profit level in the next year.

"Next year we have a difficult task of how to maintain our profit rather than increase it. We will do our best to see that our profit levels do not decline," R.C. Bhargava, managing director of the company, told a briefing.
Earlier Maruti Udyog said profit after tax for the financial year 1996/97 ending March 31 rose to 5.01 billion rupees ($139.56 million) from 4.28 billion in the previous year.
Maruti, a 50-50 joint venture between the Indian government and Japan's Suzuki Motor Corp, is India's largest carmaker.
